headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven gains while others saw modest revenue increases.
summary: Coforge led with 53.6% revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech and TCS posted double‑digit growth, driven by AI services. Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% after only 1.5% YoY growth. Several companies announced higher dividends despite mixed profit trends.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI contributed 10%+ of revenue at TCS and drove double‑digit profit growth at HCLTech and Infosys.

themes.title: Guidance revisions
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance; HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% FY27 outlook.

themes.title: Dividend hikes
themes.detail: LTM and Infosys raised interim dividends, reflecting cash generation despite slower growth.
